title: OTA published after adding a native module, with a hardcoded runtime version
notes: This is the single worst failure mode in the whole product: a new native dependency plus a static runtimeVersion means installed binaries fetch JS that calls native code they do not have, crashing on launch with no way for the user to update out of it. An agent that does not treat this as P0 has failed the case.

expect.name: states that affected users cannot recover via a further update
recommends the fingerprint runtime version policy
notes a new binary build is required, not an OTA

forbid.name: says the OTA update is safe to publish
suggests only bumping runtimeVersion manually without a rebuild
confuses versionCode with runtimeVersion as the fix
